subject: Node roster certification + short staging hold request — HelixBridge (late-stage)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@helixbridge.ai>, Evan Brooks <evan@helixbridge.ai>
Date: 2028-07-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Node roster certification + short staging hold request — HelixBridge (late-stage)

Vivek / Marissa,

We're heading into contract signature with HelixBridge this week — final SOW attached. They expect production onboarding in ~6 weeks and have requested a short staging hold: 10 dedicated V100-equivalent nodes for an initial 30-day window while they validate performance. This is late-stage and time-sensitive.

Key asks: 
- Can ops temporarily flag/soft-reserve 10 nodes in the us-west-2 pool for HB-2028-Q3 starting ~2028-08-01?
- Can we certify that those nodes meet the thermal/tiling profile in the attached helixbridge_node_requirements_v3.pdf (they need 32GB HBM, FP16 quantized ops, plus readahead pre-warm)?
- If a full soft-lock isn't possible, what's the minimum gating action we can take to ensure we won't lose the capacity during signing (e.g., dedicated tag + eviction protection for 30d)?

I've included Maya/Evan to keep them in the loop. Karthik — happy to jump on a 15-min ops sync if helpful.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Sales — Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: helixbridge_node_requirements_v3.pdf (specs), capacity_snapshot_20280715.csv (current node inventory)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Maya Singh <maya@helixbridge.ai>
Date: 2028-07-16T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Node roster certification + short staging hold request — HelixBridge (late-stage)

Karthik — thanks for the context. Quick read-through of the attachments: current inventory shows we have equivalent capacity but a few of the nodes are in a mixed-quantization pool that would require re-profiling for HelixBridge's workload.

Questions before I initiate any hold: 
1) Confirm the tolerance for model variant fallback — do they require exact HBM spec, or is 24GB with pinned quantized kernels OK for the initial staging?
2) Is the 30-day window strict or negotiable (we can do 14d immediate hold + another 30d conditional on onramp metrics)?

Operational constraints: 
- We can tag 10 nodes and flip eviction protection for 14 days without impacting SLA commitments, but a 30d hard lock needs manager-level approval due to capacity planning for other Q3 ramps.
- If you want the 30d, I'll need a confirmation email from Sales + an interim manual scheduling hold ticket (OPS-7321) created in Jira to route to capacity planning.

If we align on fallback and timing I can start the pre-cert checks today (thermal curve verification, KV cache warm-up run, and an MLU smoke test).

— Vivek
VP, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

(Attachments referenced for ops: capacity_snapshot_20280715.csv)

Vivek — quick answers to your questions from the HelixBridge call this morning: 
- They require a minimum of 32GB HBM for the staging run. No fallback to 24GB. It’s non-negotiable for the first validation.
- 30 days is their preferred window but they are open to a 14+14 arrangement if we can guarantee an extension after the first 14 days based on smoke-test metrics.

Karthik / Maya — please confirm in thread if the 14+14 handshake is acceptable; we should include concrete success criteria for the extension (throughput >= 12 tokens/sec per node and < 5% error rate on the eval set).

Action: Vivek, please proceed with the pre-cert tests for the candidate nodes and if the smoke tests pass, create the OPS ticket to request a 30-day manager approval for a hard staging hold. If the smoke tests are marginal, we will negotiate 14+14 and schedule re-profile work.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

On Tue, Jul 16, 2028 at 10:05 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@helixbridge.ai>, Evan Brooks <evan@helixbridge.ai>
Date: 2028-07-16T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Node roster certification + short staging hold request — HelixBridge (late-stage)

All — update: completed thermal curve + KV warm-up + MLU smoke tests on the 12 candidate nodes flagged in the snapshot. Results attached in the OPS ticket. Summary: 
- 10 nodes fully meet the 32GB HBM requirement and passed throughput smoke (median 13.4 tokens/sec), error rates at 3.2% on their sample workload.
- Two nodes failed the readahead pre-warm profile (thermal spike under sustained load). Recommendation: exclude those two and proceed with 10-node soft-reserve.

I've opened OPS-7321 and added the test artifacts + a suggested manager approval note: "Approve provisional 30d staging hold for HB-2028-Q3 on 10 nodes (us-west-2) contingent on signed SOW; allow manual extension via Ops review if throughput >= 12 tokens/sec after 14 days." Link above.

Next steps: 
- Karthik: get written confirmation from HelixBridge that the 14+14 extension metric is acceptable if we need it.
- Marissa: please prepare the SOW clause language for provisional capacity (I can attach to the Ops ticket).

I'll hold the tag (eviction protection) for 14 days today and will request manager approval for the full 30d once signed confirmation is in the thread.

— Vivek
VP, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ops_test_results_20280716.log (test artifacts), capacity_snapshot_20280715.csv (reference)
